caption: The drawing depicts two metallic objects with symmetrical, angular outer shapes, positioned side by side with their inner curves facing each other and their round loops aligned at the top and bottom. The object on the left has a silvery color with intricate, fine detailing and engraved patterns; it also has some sections shaded in darker tones, suggesting a dimensional, embossed surface. The object on the right is uniformly brown, lacking in visible detail, and presents as a solid form without engravings. Both objects have a central circular hole at the top and bottom, likely intended for mechanical or structural use. The drawing is centered on an off-white background, and features a handwritten script toward the lower right which appears to be a label or signature. There are no additional objects or elements in the composition.
